en: Reminiscing about days in the fields
Can't sit still after a life of labor
Reading the sky for the harvest
Holding his breath as if on the hunt
Still enough to hear a heartbeat
Lost in thought, staring at nothing
Tallying spirit stones in his head

zh: 估量着这次修炼的回报
en: Weighing the return on this session
Still swinging the hammer in spirit
Lying flat and feeling great about it
